fields.Name: T084 - Reset Modified View To Default
fields.Description: Exercises the view revert/reset-to-default path (discarding unsaved view modifications), distinct from selecting or creating a view.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Products' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type 'Products', click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Make an in-grid modification that marks the view as changed — for example click a column header to change the sort, or type into the 'Filter records...' box. Notice the saved-view selector shows a 'modified' indicator (a dot next to the view name). Open the saved-view selector panel and click 'Reset to Default'. Success is the view reverting to its default state and the modified indicator clearing.

judgeValidationCriteria: After a sort/filter change the saved-view selector shows a modified indicator (unsaved-changes dot)
Clicking 'Reset to Default' reverts the grid to the default view and the modified indicator clears (grid reloads or shows a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
